intentEvidence: Sync completed and canceled Things3 Logbook items into Obsidian daily notes.
problem: The gap between task management in Things3 and the review/note-taking process in Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Things Toolkit is derived from the MIT-licensed Things Logbook plugin by Liam Cain.
relations.plugin: Things Logbook plugin by Liam Cain

summary: Things Toolkit sync's completed and canceled Things3 Logbook items into Obsidian daily notes, providing review statistics and privacy-aware macOS access.
